reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS web_price_per_unit_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS store_price_per_unit_eur
FROM sales
WHERE net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL
  AND units IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives: SELECT country_code, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur END) / SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN units END) AS web_price_per_unit_eur, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur END) / SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN units END) AS store_price_per_unit_eur FROM sales WHERE net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL AND units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country_code

SELECT country_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') / SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_price_per_unit_eur, SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') / SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_price_per_unit_eur FROM sales WHERE NOT (net_revenue_eur IS NULL OR units IS NULL) GROUP BY 1
